description: This file contains unit tests for translation functionality in the Daux documentation generator, specifically testing translation of page labels in different languages.

classes.name: TranslateTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing translation functionalities in the Daux documentation tool.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Creates a virtual filesystem with language structure and builds a Tree Root object.

methods.name: translateDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data pairs of expected translation text and language codes for parametric testing.

methods.name: testTranslate
methods.description: Tests that the translation of a page label matches the expected translation based on the language.
